$schema-description: Pinned SPIR-V dependency commits for a Vulkan SDK release candidate of DXC.
This is the single source of truth the RC pipeline syncs the submodules to.
Format intentionally mirrors glslang's known_good.json so Vulkan SDK tooling
owners recognize it. Bump these SHAs (manually, or with `sync_deps.py --bump`)
to the agreed-upon SPIRV-Tools / SPIRV-Headers release candidate, then let the
pipeline build + validate DXC against them.
